# Ledge

> Ledge is a mobile-first, order-to-dispatch platform built for Indian FMCG distributors, super-stockists, and manufacturers. It replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and legacy ERP with one clean app for orders, stock, dealers, payments, and GST.

Ledge runs in the browser and as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA), with offline-ready order capture for field sales teams in low-connectivity areas. Pricing starts free for 30 days, then three public tiers (Free, Growth, Scale). Custom/enterprise plans are available via WhatsApp at +91 81380 84689.

## Key facts

- Built for: Indian FMCG distributors, super-stockists, manufacturers.
- Core modules: orders, stock & warehouses, dealers, sales team, schemes, targets, claims, billing, reports.
- Languages supported: English, Hindi, Malayalam.
- GST-ready invoicing, WhatsApp order sharing, role-based access (Super Admin, Sales Manager, Accountant, Salesperson).
- Free trial: 30 days, no credit card required.
- Contact: hello@getledge.in · +91 81380 84689
